creative_direction: Create a freestanding miniature bridge that passes through a tall empty rectangular frame. The bridge is ocher with one shallow arch beneath it; the frame is deep navy and slightly thicker on its left side. Show the assembly in a clear three-quarter view, with the bridge deck leading toward the center. Use a pale stone-gray ground and a single long directional shadow. Keep all surfaces matte and nearly textureless. The frame has no glass, and the bridge ends cleanly before reaching the canvas edges. Avoid railings and repetitive details. The contrast between the curved underside and rigid frame should make the compact architectural silhouette memorable.
